source_ref: Kinprove — original procedural distillation; practitioner methods and archive facts attributed to the sources listed in Sources
rationale: Original prose packaging five destination-to-origin workflows for Russian Empire emigrants through United States arrival records and Canadian transit. Artifact schemas and the example are original synthesis. Third-party sources are cited and paraphrased; no source prose, screenshots, real family records, private addresses or complete third-party tables are reproduced.
